 Order

This writ petition has been filed for the issue of a writ of mandamus, directing the second and third respondents to consider the representation made by the petitioner on 27.08.2021, wherein, the petitioner is requesting for including his name and the names of his family members for the purpose of getting compensation for the proposed acquisition of lands for the Kanadian Kalvai River Linking Project.

2.The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents based on written instructions, submitted that the compensation amount will be paid only to the pattadhar, in whose name Patta stands with respect to the subject property.
In the present case, the property belonged to the grandfather of the petitioner and the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Patta was also issued in his name.
He died and the petitioner and others are claiming the right under the grandfather as his legalheirs.
3.Under such circumstances, the third respondent shall ascertain the legal heirs of deceased Subramanian Nadar, who is the grandfather of the petitioner, by conducting an enquiry.
The compensation shall be ultimately paid to the legal heirs, by including their names in the list of persons, whose lands are being acquired for the project.

Therefore, the petitioner is directed to file a fresh representation to the third respondent and the third respondent is directed to conduct an enquiry by providing opportunity to all the concerned persons and act in line with the above observations made by this Court.
4.With the above terms, this writ petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
